description.value: Klasske's Bistro is a family-owned donair restaurant that has anchored downtown Kamloops on 3rd Avenue since 2016. Named after owner Klasske Cornborough, it specializes in Halifax-style beef and chicken donairs with house-made sauces — including a locally acclaimed sweet sauce — alongside chicken shawarma and a falafel donair for vegetarians. The recently expanded location offers indoor seating, and the kitchen accommodates advance takeout orders, making it a practical quick-stop for cyclists moving through the city centre.
